**Static reference.** JavaScript is unavailable, so here is the same
example precomputed at three temperatures, plus a bar chart at $T=1$.

Prompt: *"Given the traffic data, the agency decided to \_\_\_ the
bridge."* Logits: repair $=2.0$, monitor $=1.0$, replace $=0.5$,
close $=-0.5$, ignore $=-3.0$.

| Token | $p_i$ at $T=0.5$ | $p_i$ at $T=1.0$ | $p_i$ at $T=1.5$ |
|---|---|---|---|
| repair  | 0.8390 | 0.5953 | 0.4749 |
| monitor | 0.1135 | 0.2190 | 0.2438 |
| replace | 0.0418 | 0.1328 | 0.1747 |
| close   | 0.0057 | 0.0489 | 0.0897 |
| ignore  | 0.0000 | 0.0040 | 0.0169 |

Bar chart at $T=1.0$ (bar length is proportional to probability):

```{=html}
<svg viewBox="0 0 320 130" width="100%" height="130" role="img"
     aria-label="Bar chart of softmax probabilities at temperature 1.0: repair 0.60, monitor 0.22, replace 0.13, close 0.05, ignore 0.00">
  <text x="0" y="12" font-size="11">repair (0.5953)</text>
  <rect x="0" y="16" width="178.6" height="12" fill="#1a5fb4"></rect>
  <text x="0" y="38" font-size="11">monitor (0.2190)</text>
  <rect x="0" y="42" width="65.7" height="12" fill="#1a5fb4"></rect>
  <text x="0" y="64" font-size="11">replace (0.1328)</text>
  <rect x="0" y="68" width="39.8" height="12" fill="#1a5fb4"></rect>
  <text x="0" y="90" font-size="11">close (0.0489)</text>
  <rect x="0" y="94" width="14.7" height="12" fill="#1a5fb4"></rect>
  <text x="0" y="116" font-size="11">ignore (0.0040)</text>
  <rect x="0" y="120" width="1.2" height="12" fill="#1a5fb4"></rect>
</svg>
```

As $T$ falls toward 0, probability mass concentrates on the highest logit
(argmax, here "repair"); as $T$ grows, the distribution flattens toward
uniform. See the "Temperature and sampling" section above for why.

:::
